text:
Alrighty. I'm true to my word, kid. You won, you got yourself a new tower guard. I'm gonna guess there's a uniform that goes with it? 
Well then, I won't be needing this. Have it, kid, you could use some protection with those skinny legs anyways.

E-e-excuse me? %PCRace? I noticed you come out of the tower, so... is it true? Is Muatra dead?
Oh.... this is... not good. If he is dead, who will guard the tower?
I don't recognize your face. Tell me, what brings you to my fighting ring?
Perhaps work is what you seek? In large quantities, we possess it. Perhaps taking down a ring of fabricant fighters would entice that which sits before me.
I see! You have found me! But now you must fight me! And you will die! Against me!
Ha HA! Fool! You should have known better than to trust me! For I am the great Mage Dareathan and you are now in my maze of DEATH.
Well hello, my good... person! Yes, person! Person with legs! Person with brain! Do you, person, want to help me with my great work?

You come to me. You talk to me. There could be many reasons for this. More than likely, you seek out quartz armor. I make it, I sell it, you were wise indeed if this is your goal. But I cannot make quartz at the moment. It is what I lack.

Miri was the killer? That's a real shame. She seemed like a sweet girl. I suppose that's how it always is though, eh? You think everyone is all nice on the outside, then you find twenty faces in their closet. I suppose I should thank you for saving my girls though, so take this.

Damn! I knew I was taking a risk siccing those skeletons on you! 
Yes, you idiot, the 'innocent' stripper is, in fact, the evil killer who has been stealing body parts. Some of us have to make money, and you think dancing is enough to live richly? Think again! Augmentations cost a fortune, and the components sell for just as much. Really though, nobody will miss a few harlots, right? Except apparently you. Ah well, I'm sure your equipment will be worth a fortune.

My house isn't too far, just down the la-

I...

Bah! The words of someone who doesn't know either. Your theory just as valid as mine. Interesting, equally valid. Equal. Therefore, you are competition. I don't want competition. You have freed me, so face the consequences of your ideals!

text: You, outsider, are you skilled in the art of acrobatics, jumping, or leaping? If so, I have work, a job, a task.
(The headless man waves his arms around, pointing to his neck)
Come to make fun of the hanged man? Or are you one of the delinquents, suddenly given to a change of heart, and thus you've come back to return to me my errant body parts?
If I'm distracted, please, don't blame me. It's those damn fabricant slaughterfish in the water.
I knew it! Interlopers! Interlopers from outside the city, come to defile our Lord's machinations! If I must be the final line of defense, so be it! Have at you!
I... perhaps your words ring true. If this is merely the result of some idiotic experiment, it would violate Sotha Sil's glorious city, and create quite a mess. I will not interfere.
No, no! I won't listen to your lies! I see your true intent in your soul! You cannot escape the righteous!

What are you DOING? Do you not realize that this, this... whatever this is, is a gift from the Clockwork God himself?! It is far too precious, far too... things! And I will not let you defile such a holy relic, even if I must pay with my LIFE.

text:
Hey, you, friend, yeah, you.
Heard you've got quite a reputation back where you're from. Are you willing to do a little job for me?

You... are... not... my... host...
But... I... feel... your... mind. You... are... worthy. We... may... talk.
Speak... interesting... one.
Hm? Well it seems I'm being rather strange to me today. I would have sworn I wouldn't dream up something as weird as what's in front of me. I continue to surprise me.
Hello me. I hope I am doing well today.
Chairs and tables and chairs and tables and get out no time for you and crates on top of crates and more crates and stacking.
Stacking stacking stacking everything must be stacked stacked tables on top of tables dressers on dressers shut up not crazy.
Do not be alarmed. We will not harm you. We are the hivemind, and we really are getting sick of talking like this.

You there, yes you! Sera, let me tell you that you look like the kind of person who needs something in life, yessir! Something you've always been missing and let me tell you, let me tell you right now, serjo, I have EXACTLY what it is you are looking for right here, for the tiniest of fees, and it can be all yours! And if that isn't it, then no doubt one of these FABULOUS wares will entice someone of your class!
Wares of all types! Best in the city! You want it, I've got it!
*Whir whir* *Psssh* *Clank clank*?
*Ppsss* *Whum* *Buzzzzzzz* *Fssssssssss*
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHhy are you not screaming? You do realize you're falling through the air right now!
You know, sometimes I wish I could stop falling. But we can't always have what we want.
Stay back! Back I say! I'm contagious! You don't want to catch it as well!
I am not long for this world, I fear!

Well hello there! I haven't seen your face around the city before. A newcomer? Ah, thought so. How about you and I go back to my house and swap body parts? No? Well my door is always open, and my joints are always lose and ready for some... removal.
Still up for some limbless fun? No? Your loss friend.
Oh ho ho! A new one! What color is your blood, little wanderer? Is it green? Oh, or blue! Or maybe invisible blood? Which is the best kind because it's everywhere and you don't even know it!
I can hear your heart beating and pumping. If ever you've a cut, little wanderer, come to me. I'll take good care of it.

Ah, are you part of the... new clergy? Do you know my son? He was such a good boy, always full of thought. I remember the time my fabricant goats were filled with thoughts. Though of course, it was because me and Thegavi-235 had found thought in its gaseous form and decided to fill the goats with it using a pump.... My son was a good boy. Shame the rewounds took him.
It's good to see you again, boy. You are a boy, right?

Well well, it looks as if the rock swimming in the valley of cheese has finally meandered over towards talking to the priest of nonsense logic. Perhaps what flowers you will dig up will be of benefit to both of us, no?
Walk with five feet friend.

Before you start going off on how 'evil' or 'unnatural' I am, I'd like you to know that I am an officially sanctioned practioner of necromancy, and the Archcanon himself gave explicit permission for me to experiment! So there! Take your prejudices and shove them where the gear doesn't turn!
I'm watching, %PCName. If you take out any holy weapons I'll call the Watchmen.
Hey Aroban! Another round over here, and leave the spoon in! I'm feeling a bit peckish! Sorry friend, how can I help you?
Ah, good old %PCname! How goes life, eat anything good recently?
Oh... %PCName, this is our first meeting, how sad. It is a shame that greetings must be so sorrowful for one who moves backwards in time. Though perhaps it will only get better from here.
Good to see you before %PCName, I trust you will have luck in the future with that giant mudcrab?

The stock says you've got the smell of blood on you. Which means you've probably killed fabricants before. I'll give you the benefit of the doubt though, I have heard that in the lower levels the worker drones have all gone mad.
Ah, %PCName, both me and the stock are happy to see you.
You're not a farmer are you? No? Well then, I sssssssuppose it's sssssssssafe enough to talk. Sssssssssorry, I have a bit of a condition.
Do you need information?
Clocks for clocks! Imperfections for imperfections! Oddities for oddities! Plenty on my cart, plenty on your minds, let's trade!
Unfaithful! Treacherous! Cheati- Oh hell, sera, if you've come to loot the house, I'm afraid you might want to wait, me and my... husband, are in the middle of a little something.
...Please go?

Ah, a visitor! Welcome, welcome! Please, stay as long as you like, so long as you keep your hands to yourself. Delicate instruments, you know. I have to make do with shoddy Chimer-made stuff, not proper Dwemeri tools. Probably not a good cutting sphere for miles.
Welcome back. I'm always glad for the company.
Ahoy, muthsera! You should get out of the ocean, before you drown! Also, why are you even in it in the first place? Ship sank? Or just decided to go for a very long swim!
Ahoy again, muthsera! Still sailing the ocean like me?
Sorry, I can't move, I'm a statue.
I will char your face and make love to the subsequent ashes.
You and your organs will be my slave once I am free of this disgusting mortal body.
You lookin thirsty, frond? Frined? Friend? Yeah, thas it. Friend. You got coin, I got some booze.
*hic* 'Nother round, on me, on me! Ha! Ha!

Shut up, alright! I said shut up, it's my turn to talk! You can tell them about that later, I've got the body right now!
Sorry about that, %PCRace, my other me is forgetting our little AGREEMENT. Shut up! You did!
We really need to find a way to fix this. No we don't.

I swear, I haven't done anything.
Oh. Not a guard. Quite confusing with all that armor really. Might want to stay back though, friend. You don't want to get burned.
Stay out of the sun. It's worked for me.
Rewounds. Leave. We have business.
You are not the merchant. Leave.

They... they tore off his arm! Didn't even bother with anything else, just ran right up and ripped it off! Why? Why? I told him, I warned him that augmentations are bad luck but he didn't listen! Poor Uran!
Very well, I admit that I may have misinterpreted what kind of adventurer you are. You are obviously the kind I have to kill myself.

text: But, like so many times before, an adventurer stands in my way. And like so many times before, I have to kill them. Yet, unlike all those times, I have a bit more power, leisure, and tools at my disposal, so if you'll excuse me, I think I'll kill you in a slow, ironic way. We all must have our vices, no? You two! Dump this meddler in the pit! We'll have Counterfeint deal with them.

Stumbling upon this city was an accident on my part, but I've always been good at adapting. Hence the pamphlets and moon sugar trade. These riots were an unintended side-effect of a few early money-grabbing schemes, but now I've found that widening the gap works well for business. Hah, as they squabble and bicker, all the while I dance between them pocketing their coin. When all is said and done, I'll return to Nirn the way I came, a much richer man.

Oh yes, the Abstemious are right to assume that an outside force has been encouraging this... let's call it 'class warfare'. But for all their brilliance they really can't tell the difference between a transicant and a normal fabricant. You see, %PCRace, I am... not from these parts. After a few, shall we say, 'investments' turned sour back in Narsis, I sought a way to return to my seat on the Hlaalu council, and in turn regain my wealth.

Quite a persistent adventurer aren't you? Two dead ends I took great pains to create, both uncovered, and still you persist! I'd have thought you would have pointed the finger at someone by now. But from my experience you adventurer types need to be led around on a string, as was always the case back in House Hlaalu.

And why would I believe you? Especially after explaining just what one might do with this jewel? And you were able to reach something nobody else should have been able to reach, and then tell us we have to stop. The only thing I can conclude from that is simple; you are a spy or a saboteur, determined to stop progress. Well, let me tell what we do to your kind in this city, friend!

text: I am busy. Please leave.
Please leave.

So the pawn moves into place, and greater powers move it once more. Welcome, %PCRace, to the heart of the heart. I am the Tree.

I have watched you since you entered my domain. You are a traveler, and thus you may be used in conflicts that do not concern you. I know you wish to enter the inner sanctum of the Quartz King, but to do so the Arboretum must be first be cured. It is here our interests coincide, though I cannot say more. Seek from the Gardener access to the Lower Arboretum, and once in there, seek its crystal core. Complete the tasks he has given you so far, and say nothing of me or our meeting.
You work, a willing pawn, knowing not what you do, nor does he.
How goes your work on the infection?
Ah, %PCName, so glad we are able to once again meet! No doubt the Archcanon has sent you to deal with the infection?
Access to the Slums is restricted, under orders of the Archcanon. I am here to make sure that those orders are upheld.
WE. STAND. GUARD. ONE. CAN. NEVER. BE. SURE.

YOU. ARE. ALLOWED. BEWARE. THE. MAD. 
ONE. OF. OURS. ALREADY. LOST.
DISTRICT. CLOSED. FOR. YOUR. SAFETY. STAY. AWAY.
Watch, wonder, build, and tear down, Nerevar.

It is has been so very long since we last met, Nerevar. It is a great shame that you did not keep your hair, for I recall it was quite the conversation piece. Ah, but that isn't relevant now. We have met to discuss larger matters, for I hear you wish to reach Sotha Sil.
Salutations, traveler! I welcome you to the Garden of Akatosh.
So the look-alike has arived. You invade my homeland and murder my vassals and liegemer. I am Indoril Nerevar Mora, Hortator and ruler of Resdaynia, and by my ancestors you shall not escape alive!
Another one? Come to make fun of poor Salms for daring to speak his mind?
Stay back, stay back! You have metal on you, I'm sure of it!
Keeping out of the shrubs, I hope? They took a long time to engineer.

What are you doing in here? You're not here to take away my experiments, are you? Or worse, walk around in my conductor shrubs? I cannot allow that, so if you are I-
You're not here to walk around and ruin my shrubs? Oh dear, I've made a fool of myself. I suppose it was inevitable; I get far too absorbed in my work.

My lord bids me to stop your intrusion, and so I shall. You have bested his advisers, and seek now to murder the Hortator. I am Serjo Indoril's champion and his most faithful vassal, Voryn Dagoth, and you will never meet him on the field of combat but through me.
So. You've killed the clown with pretensions of power. I am the Face-Snaked Queen of the Three-in-One, and you'll not find me so easy to best.
Do you know me by my names, outlander? I am the demon-god of the star-wounded east, Vehk and Vehk, the martial axiom. You will die by a thousand cuts unseen, for I am lord of the middle air.
I've not seen you before. You new in Sotha Sil? Well, welcome, we're all friendly here, sera.
A visitor! I've never seen one! Is it true you breathe fire and have plants in place of your mechanisms?
I don't know you, do you need something?
If I haven't said it before, welcome to Sotha Sil.
How do you like our city, %PCRace? It can be much more confusing than the cities from your world.
In these troubled times, I feel like I need a drink. Though, I suppose, welcome to Sotha Sil; it's usually in better shape than this.
While I have nothing personal against you, let me say from the start that you'll do more harm than good to Sotha Sil. We have enough problems as it is.
Watch where you step in Sotha Sil, %PCRace; the city is always full of surprises.
We're all devout here in Sotha Sil, friend.
Greetings, %PCRace.

The winds have whispered to me, %PCName. They have told me of your failure to enter Hrothmund's Barrow. In order to become chieftain of Thirsk, you needed to enter the barrow and grasp the axe of Hrothmund to receive his blessing. Now, that will never happen. This is a sad day. I fear Thirsk will never reopen.
Might want to get your mechanisms checked, you sound sick.
You seem a bit sickly, you're not broken, are you?
You've got the corprus! There's no cure for that, is there?

Enjoying the city, %PCName?
Watch, Wonder, Build, and Tear Down, %PCName

Watch, Wonder, Build, and Tear Down, %PCName.

The name's Kummuuuu, I run this here emporium. To be more accurate, it's more like a garbage dump. That lift up there and that pit over there leads to the lower levels, where I dredge up anything I can find. I do get some good things, equipment, automatons, and torches.
I have far too many torches.
I... am... Hahnab-222. This... vessel... holds... my mind. It... allows... me.... to... speak... where... otherwise... I... would... not. He... is... willing... and... I... treat... him... well.
Oh me, you know who I am, because you're me. Everything is. Just my dream. Just like everything.
Up and down and up and down and can't talk stacking shut up shut up shut up. Yabin-721 is stacking, chairs on chairs, be quiet.

We are the hivemind, Thovum-3. We were born with one soul, but three bodies share it. We have no evil plans. We are not dangerous. Please do not hurt us. We are being completely serious. We have been chased from life to life, because of our abilities.
Sotha Sil Sathgeli at your service, and let me tell you for today only I have the exact wares that YOU need.
*Psssssssssssssssssssssssssshhhhhhhh* *Clunk*

I don't actually know. Everything has been falling for so long. Just endless falling. And the feeling of falling. It's not so bad actually, once you realize you'll never hit the ground you really just learn to live with it.
Haleneri-911. I'm an invalid at the moment, and highly contagious. It seems every week I've got some new disease! It's horrible being as sick as I am.
Wanting to get a little more personal, huh? Oh, I like that. Well, sweetheart, my name is Innuo-101, and I can show you a thing or two about limb removal.

Ullazali-20, little wanderer, and yes, I'm aware I've got a little problem. But blood is just so... enticing. The way it flows from a body, the the way it collects in my little bottles. All the little colors it can be. Oh my. And then there's the blood of gods, from ebony to aetherium to quartz. Beautiful.

Hm. Oh you know who I am! Everyone does! I am Sotha Sil, the god of clockwork. I think?
Or maybe I dressed as him for a party. Or perhaps Sotha Sil dressed as Goveri-999 for that party. And that's me. I wonder if he acknowledged my costume...

They call me the old man. And by 'they' I refer to the walkers in sense, not the small eyed doves that eat moths every friday. If I have a name, I forgot it. Or, it is lost to the annals of baking. It probably had quite a few numbers in it. Everyone's names seem to have those these days.

Merely call me Lord Favthali. I'm not really a lord, but I suppose when one has researched fabricant undead as much as I have, one gets an honorary title. And yes, I am a lich, don't try to kill me you silly adventurer.
Well, if I am what I eat, then I'm everything! Hah! But my name is Devarthi-876. I eat things.
Selethi-01, as you will already know. Fabricant unfortune teller, and seer of the future, though not the past. I remember what will happen, and can only guess on what has happened.
Nagalan-500, in-depth farmer, speaker of fabricants. They say you're probably an adventurer, and I'd believe them if I were you. The stock is usually right about these things.
Talissss-42. I'm not really usssssed to being ssssocial, mosssstly becaussse of my condition, but converssssation is well appreciated.
